text:
Sam: Hey team — working on my first PR. Quick q: what's our lightweight checklist for getting a PR merged? Branch naming, commit msg, tests, reviewers to ping?

Alex (DevEx): Welcome, Sam! Nice. Short checklist: branch pattern is feature/<TICKET>-short-desc or fix/<TICKET>-short-desc for bugs. Commit msg convention: <type>(scope): brief summary — e.g., feat(api): add health endpoint. Run tests and lint locally (see commands below). Add changelog entry if user-facing. Tag codeowners for review and add the appropriate labels. Full guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/pr-guide

Mira: A few extra tips — keep PRs small (< ~300 LOC), split refactors into separate PRs. Use Draft PRs for WIP. Label with things like needs-review, needs-design, or needs-qa.

Olivia: Reviewer expectations: include how-you-tested in the PR body, add unit/integration tests where applicable, and note performance considerations for runtime code. If it's infra/ops touching, ping @eng-infra. For UI: include screenshots or a short recording.

Sam: Thanks! Any CI flake things to watch for? My initial build failed on macos runner once.

CI Bot: build #452 failed: flake8/format errors. Excerpt: 'E231 missing whitespace after ,'. Run `make lint` or `pre-commit run --all-files` locally. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/452/logs

Alex (DevEx): We usually prefer squash merges for feature branches unless the owner requests to preserve history. Commit signing/signed commits aren't required for new hires — we can enable that later. Also run `yarn test --watchAll=false` (js) or `pytest -q` (py) before opening for review.

Sam: Good to know. What about hotfix vs release branching, and who is allowed to merge?

Mira: Hotfix pattern: hotfix/<TICKET>-desc. Release PRs go through the release manager — check #release-war-room or ping @release-oncall. Normal flow: after approvals + green CI + no blocked labels, PR owner can merge. If touching multiple services, coordinate with the owners in the PR.

Olivia: Small practical command: run pre-commit and linting quickly: 
```
# run pre-commit hooks locally
pipx run pre-commit run --all-files
# or if using repo toolchain
pre-commit run --all-files
```
Also please include a short 'How I tested' section in the PR template; reviewers will check that first.

Sam: Perfect. I'll open a draft PR now referencing TICKET-123 and pinging @Mira. Thanks everyone :tada:

Alex (DevEx): Welcome again — ping me if CI keeps being flaky, we can add a CI ticket.

Mira: Happy to review once it's ready.

Olivia: +1 to keeping the first PR small. We'll walk through the review together if you want.
